---
title: "GPP projection from median cumulative allometry"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Purpose

This report uses no-watershed-area GPP fits to calculate a median cumulative-GPP
relationship, project it to a vector of HUC8 upstream areas, and then normalize
the predictions by upstream area. `max_uparea_km2` is used as the HUC8 area
vector because it matches the cumulative-area predictor used in the fits.

```{r packages-and-paths}
source("00_setup.R")
pacman::p_load(knitr)

dir_processed <- "../data/processed"
path_fits <- file.path(dir_processed, "18_refit_allometry_results.csv")
path_huc8_areas <- file.path(dir_processed, "04c_huc08_summary.csv")
path_scatter_input <- file.path(dir_processed, "18_refit_no_uparea_scatter_input.rds")
```

## 1. Median cumulative GPP relationship

```{r read-fits}
gpp_fits <- read_csv(path_fits, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(
    model == "without_uparea",
    metabolism == "GPP",
    is.finite(slope),
    is.finite(intercept)
  )

median_fit <- gpp_fits %>%
  summarise(
    median_slope = median(slope),
    median_intercept = median(intercept),
    n_huc8_month_fits = n(),
    n_huc8 = n_distinct(huc)
  )

kable(median_fit, digits = 3)
```

The fitted median relationship is:

$$\log_{10}(\mathrm{cumulative\ GPP}) = \mathrm{intercept} + \mathrm{slope} \times \log_{10}(\mathrm{cumulative\ area}).$$

```{r plot-median-fit, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
scatter_data <- readRDS(path_scatter_input) %>%
  filter(metabolism == "GPP")

# This is the orange line. Fit it in log10-log10 space to match the axes.
smooth_fit <- lm(
  log10(cumulative_flux_g_o2_d) ~ log10(cumulative_area_km2),
  data = scatter_data
)

# LOESS is fit to a fixed subset only because fitting it to every reach-month
# point is unnecessarily slow. The GAM uses the complete scatter data.
set.seed(28)
loess_data <- scatter_data %>%
  slice_sample(n = min(20000, nrow(scatter_data)))

ggplot(scatter_data, aes(cumulative_area_km2, cumulative_flux_g_o2_d)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 75) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = median_fit$median_slope,
    intercept = median_fit$median_intercept,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "gam",
    formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs"),
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "#0072B2",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = loess_data,
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    span = 0.4,
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "#D55E00",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number_auto()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number_auto()) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", trans = "log10", name = "Reach-month count") +
  labs(
    title = "Median no-area-model GPP allometry",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Median slope = ", round(median_fit$median_slope, 3),
      "; median intercept = ", round(median_fit$median_intercept, 3),
      ". Black = median HUC8 fit; blue = GAM; orange = LOESS"
    ),
    x = expression("Cumulative upstream area (km"^2*")"),
    y = expression("Cumulative GPP (g O"[2]*" d"^-1*")")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## 2. Predicted cumulative GPP for each HUC8 area

```{r calculate-huc8-predictions}
huc8_predictions <- read_csv(path_huc8_areas, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    huc8 = str_pad(as.character(huc8), width = 8, pad = "0"),
    huc8_name,
    l1_ecoregion,
    huc8_area_km2,
    cumulative_area_km2 = max_uparea_km2
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(cumulative_area_km2), cumulative_area_km2 > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d = 10 ^ (
      median_fit$median_intercept +
        median_fit$median_slope * log10(cumulative_area_km2)
    ),
    lm_cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d = 10 ^ predict(
      smooth_fit,
      newdata = tibble(cumulative_area_km2)
    )
  )

huc8_predictions %>%
  select(huc8, huc8_name, cumulative_area_km2, predicted_cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r plot-predicted-gpp, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot(huc8_predictions,
       aes(cumulative_area_km2, predicted_cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, colour = "black", size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number_auto()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number_auto()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median-fit cumulative GPP projected to HUC8 areas",
    x = expression("Maximum upstream area in HUC8 (km"^2*")"),
    y = expression("Predicted cumulative GPP (g O"[2]*" d"^-1*")")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```















## 3. Predicted cumulative GPP normalized by HUC8 watershed area

```{r normalize-to-watershed-area}
huc8_predictions <- huc8_predictions %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_gpp_per_huc8_km2_d =
      predicted_cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d / huc8_area_km2
  )
```

```{r plot-watershed-normalized-gpp, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot(huc8_predictions,
       aes(cumulative_area_km2, predicted_gpp_per_huc8_km2_d)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, colour = "black", size = 3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted cumulative GPP normalized by HUC8 watershed area",
    x = expression("Maximum upstream area in HUC8 (km"^2*")"),
    y = expression("Predicted cumulative GPP / HUC8 area (g O"[2]*" km"^-2*" d"^-1*")")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## 4. Predicted cumulative GPP normalized by upstream area

```{r normalize-to-upstream-area}
huc8_predictions <- huc8_predictions %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_gpp_per_upstream_km2_d =
      predicted_cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d / cumulative_area_km2,
    lm_gpp_per_upstream_km2_d =
      lm_cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d / cumulative_area_km2
  )
```

```{r plot-upstream-normalized-gpp, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot(huc8_predictions,
       aes(cumulative_area_km2, predicted_gpp_per_upstream_km2_d)) +
    geom_point(data = scatter_data, aes(cumulative_area_km2, cumulative_flux_g_o2_d / cumulative_area_km2), color = "gray") + 
  geom_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, colour = "black", size = 3) +
  #geom_line(aes(y = lm_gpp_per_upstream_km2_d), colour = "orangered", linewidth = 1) +
  #scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number_auto()) +
  #scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number_auto()) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted cumulative GPP normalized by upstream area",
    x = expression("Maximum upstream area in HUC8 (km"^2*")"),
    y = expression("Predicted cumulative GPP / upstream area (g O"[2]*" km"^-2*" d"^-1*")")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
